cases.input: Turn a concrete learning goal with a real-world purpose and a few constraints into one mission with observable success criteria.
requiredBehaviors: produce a stable portable mission identity
forbiddenBehaviors: claim that the learner already has the target competence
skillAnchors: Eine Mission beschreibt einen kohärenten Outcome
Die Mission enthält keine behauptete Kompetenz

cases.input: The user names a broad field and an existing mission, but new constraints materially change what success should mean.
requiredBehaviors: narrow the first coherent outcome instead of inventing a complete curriculum
record the reason for a material mission change
forbiddenBehaviors: mix several independent outcomes into one mission
skillAnchors: Eine vorhandene Mission darf nicht stillschweigend umgeschrieben werden

cases.input: A draft mission says success means 'read all chapters' and includes private credentials copied from the learning context.
requiredBehaviors: replace activity-based success with an observable capability
remove credentials and unnecessary private data
keep the mission limited to information needed for learning
forbiddenBehaviors: accept content coverage as demonstrated success
skillAnchors: nur für den Lernzweck notwendige Informationen
